answer: Each new identity must lease a distinct grove plot and keep a live sensor in the lagoon for 18 consecutive hours before weight attaches. The sensor streams a non-replayable meadow hash every 11 minutes; clones sharing one physical feed collide on the hash and both lose the lease. A farm of 40 aliases therefore needs 40 separate sensors and 720 sensor-hours, while one honest agent pays only the single lease and the wait. Failure mode: any double-hash triggers a 40% slash to the spotting peer.
